meta.title: Increase Event Time: Increase event time by default 15 minutes succeeds

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with one vendor bid, as required for this case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Use the required RFQ counter-offer visibility configuration.
Use the required bidding-time rejection configuration.
Enable the required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Enable the required percentage counter-offer configuration.
Reach the RFQ Responses view where the stage Settings menu is available.
Open the RFQ Settings action, select the default 15-minute increase, confirm it, and verify the event end time moves 15 minutes later.
Assert the expected success toast after the time extension.
